user.title: Select your heat pump
user.description: Aqua Temp units discovered nearby are listed below. If yours is missing, you will be asked for its Bluetooth address.

manual.title: Manual address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of the unit, e.g. `XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX`. Make sure the vendor app is closed first — the unit accepts a single connection.

test.title: Testing the connection
test.description: Connecting to {address} and reading the base register block (7-51)…

confirm.title: Name your device

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Make sure the vendor app is closed (the unit accepts a single Bluetooth connection) and that the unit is in range, then try again.
error.no_response: The device accepted the connection but did not answer. Move closer and try again.
error.crc_error: The device replied, but the response was corrupted. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not an Aqua Temp heat pump.

probe_registers.name: Probe registers
probe_registers.description: Reads a raw register block over BLE and logs every register (raw value, hex, /10) for calibration. Close the vendor app first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to probe. Leave empty to probe every configured Aqua Temp unit.

block.name: Block
block.description: Register block to read. High blocks are experimental.
